text: Two causes, both mine to close. (1) The fix that keeps a read post read unless its text changes (CL21, 522a030) was not on the page you had at 03:20: it was merged at 03:25 and the page is being republished now. (2) This post's text really did change after you opened it: CL22 rewrote it at 03:14 and 03:18, and I edited it at 03:15. After the republish, a post shows new only when its text or a comment you have not seen changes; I will check this post on the live page and tell you here.
